tagline: Join the numbers. Get to 2048. Or race a friend to it.
description:
The original 2048 — swipe or use the arrow keys, merge matching tiles, and try to build the 2048 tile. Your game is saved on this device, inside the app, so you can close it and pick up where you left off.

Want a race? Press Play a friend, then press Invite (in the GifOS menu) and send the link. You both start from the same tiles. First to 2048 wins. If someone runs out of moves, the other can keep going — highest score takes it once every board is stuck. Each of you plays your own board; the list of live scores updates as you go. Playing alone is the original game, exactly.

An unofficial port of 2048 by Gabriele Cirulli.
